decision.reason: [ev-8c0cecc71daf] gives only one bullet point: Loki will automatically attempt to populate a `service_name` label on ingestion. For details it refers to a separate "`service_name` label" section, and that section is not among the evidence. The bullet does not say which environments are exposed (for example, which ingestion paths or existing labels trigger the behavior, or whether it can be turned off). It also does not say what happens to an operator who does nothing, such as changes to stream cardinality or to queries. The referenced section of the upgrade guide is needed before applicability and consequence can be written.
